zh_name: 香水/美妆瓶身包装样机合集
purpose: Studio-lit glass-bottle product mockups for perfume/cosmetic brand launches and beauty social-media teasers.
target_user: Cosmetics/fragrance brands, beauty e-commerce sellers, brand-launch marketers
content_gap: '香水瓶' and 'perfume bottle' both return only 4 wrong-type results (sport/water bottles); no dedicated perfume/cosmetic bottle content exists in the catalog.
discovery_reason: PARTIAL content gap, MEDIUM-HIGH confidence, rank #6 (P1, PROVISIONAL) -- general adjacent content exists (ruling out total search failure) but the specific bottle sub-type is absent; has the best competitor-image evidence of the whole pool (3 adjacent images on file).
competitor_references: Adjacent (not exact): 7.9 xiaohongshu aromatherapy/scent-product teaser images (Bing/Google/Pinterest all show on-topic aromatherapy/scent-bottle product imagery).
fixed_layout_structure: Centered glass-bottle silhouette product mockup, occupying ~50% of vertical frame height, fully visible
Soft studio-lighting backdrop with a subtle gradient and soft shadow beneath the bottle
Label area on the bottle body reserved for the brand/product name
Small brand wordmark repeated at the bottom of the frame (~bottom 10%), understated
information_hierarchy: 1) bottle silhouette (dominant visual) 2) label brand/product name on the bottle 3) bottom wordmark (smallest)
visual_style: Glass-bottle silhouette mockup with editable label area, soft studio-lighting product-photo aesthetic matching the k-beauty/Y2K-chrome competitor visual language
typography_direction: Minimal elegant serif or thin sans-serif for the label brand name; small caps for bottom wordmark
color_direction: Soft studio tones -- pastel gradient backdrops (blush, sage, lavender, chrome) depending on product line
prompt_template: Design a studio product-photography style MOCKUP of a perfume or cosmetic bottle, {aspect_ratio} portrait aspect ratio, output size {output_size}. FIXED LAYOUT (must match across every variant of this template): one centered glass-bottle silhouette occupying about half the frame height, fully visible with nothing cropped; a soft studio-lighting backdrop with a subtle gradient and a soft shadow beneath the bottle; a label area on the bottle body reserved for the brand/product name; a small, understated brand wordmark repeated at the very bottom of the frame. VARIABLE CONTENT for this specific example: bottle shape = {bottle_shape_variant}, label brand/product name text = "{brand_name} - {product_name}", backdrop tone = {backdrop_tone}, palette = {palette}. Render the label brand/product name as real, legible, correctly spelled text on the bottle label. Do not add a watermark. Do not crop the bottle at the frame edges.
negative_constraints: no stock-photo watermark text or agency logos
no extra/duplicate text blocks beyond the specified text_slots
no misspelled or garbled text -- render all specified text exactly as given, legible at output resolution
no meta-references (no 'template', 'placeholder', 'lorem ipsum', or design-tool UI chrome in the image)
no cropped or clipped subject at the edges of the frame
no low-contrast text over busy backgrounds -- keep all text slots on a readable, sufficiently contrasted zone
must be a perfume/cosmetic bottle shape, not a sport or water bottle
bottle must not be cropped at the frame edges
quality_criteria: bottle silhouette clearly reads as a perfume/cosmetic container, not a sport/water bottle
label text is legible and correctly spelled
studio-lighting backdrop with soft shadow is present
